title: Optimization of antigen-specific CD8+ T cell activation conditions for infectious diseases including COVID-19
protocol: Manipulate the blood tube in the biological hood.
Gently transfer 1 ml blood to a 15 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 10 ml RBC lysis buffer carefully using a serological pipette.
Vortex the microcentrifuge tube briefly and put it still for 10 min at 25°C.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and add 15 ml BSM buffer, repeat centrifugation as in step d.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells in 100 μl BSM buffer.
Count viable cells and adjust to 5–10 × 10^6 cells/ml with BSM buffer.
Distribute cell suspension into 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes with 100 μl/tube (5–10 × 10^5 cells/tube, at least 2 tubes).
Add 5 μL Human TruStain FcX™ per million cells in 100 μL staining volume.
Mix and incubate for 10 min at 25°C.
Incubate on ice for 20 min with 5 μL PE anti-human HLA-A2 antibody per million cells in a 100 μL staining volume, in the dark.
Wash twice with 1.5 mL cell staining buffer by centrifugation at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μL cell staining buffer.
Add 5 μL/million cells of 7-AAD viability staining solution to exclude dead cells.
Incubate on ice for 3–5 min, in the dark.
Perform flow cytometric analysis.
Pause the experiment if samples cannot be read immediately on a flow cytometer.
Keep foil-wrapped samples in a refrigerator between 4°C and 8°C for less than 4 hours.
Resuspend samples in cell staining buffer before analysis.
Avoid keeping samples in fixation buffer for extended periods to prevent changes in fluorophore conformation and fluorescence.
Prewarm the LSM at 25°C.
Thoroughly mix the LSM by gently flipping the bottle.
Fill one 15 mL Falcon tube with 4 mL LSM for each sample.
Fill another 15 mL Falcon tube with 4 mL PBS for each sample.
Label the tubes properly, including sample ID and solution type.
Mix 4 mL heparinized blood with 4 mL PBS.
Carefully layer the diluted blood over the 4 mL LSM to create a distinct interface.
Centrifuge the tube at 805 × g for 20 minutes at 25°C.
Open the centrifugation bucket in the hood after centrifugation.
Retrieve PBMCs into a 15 mL Falcon pre-filled with PBS using a 2 mL serological pipette.
Wash cells twice with 10 mL PBS by centrifuging at 300 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Label cryovials properly, and put them on ice in the biological safety cabinet.
Centrifuge the isolated PBMCs at 300 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells in a suitable volume of cell freezing medium to make a cell concentration of 2–10 × 10^6 cells/mL (keep the cells on ice).
Mix the cell suspension gently.
Transfer 1 mL cell suspension into the cryovials on ice.
Place the container in a −80°C freezer for a minimum of 12 h.
Transfer the cryovials to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Incubate the frozen PBMCs with 100 μg/mL DNase I solution for at least 15 min at 25°C before labeling and separation.
Filter the cell suspension with 37 μm cell filters to obtain optimal results.
Prepare cell suspension at 5 × 10^7 cells/mL in EasySep™ buffer.
Add samples to 5 mL polystyrene round-bottom tubes.
Mix isolation cocktail with sample, using 50 μL/mL of sample volume.
Incubate the mixture at 25°C for 5 minutes.
Vortex RapidSpheres™ and keep them at 25°C for 30 seconds.
Add RapidSpheres™ to the sample and mix again, using 50 μL/mL of sample volume.
Top up the sample with EasySep™ buffer to reach a total volume of 2.5 mL.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down two to three times.
Place the tube in a magnet and incubate at 25°C for 3 minutes.
Invert the magnet and tube together, pouring the enriched cell suspension into a new tube.
Keep the magnet and tube inverted for 2–3 seconds before returning upright.
Do not shake or wipe off any drops from the tube orifice.
Centrifuge the purified CD8+ T cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend the CD8+ T cells in primary T cell medium.
Warm mitomycin C tube at 37°C and shake in an ultrasonic bath for higher solubility.
Harvest T2-A2 cells from T-75 cell culture flasks by agitation and aspiration using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Transfer the harvested cells to a fresh 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells in complete IMDM to a final concentration of approximately 1–2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer T2-A2 cells (2 mL/well) into the 6-well plate.
Add mitomycin C (20 μg/mL) per well.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 30 min.
Wash twice with PBS and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Dilute 5 mM CFSE in DMSO to a final concentration of 5 μM in PBS, making a total volume of 1 mL.
Resuspend 2–4 × 10^8 T2-A2 cells with 1 mL PBS.
Mix resuspended cells with 1 μL 5 mM CFSE (final concentration is 5 μM).
Incubate the mixture at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 30 min with agitation.
Stop labeling reaction by adding 9 mL complete IMDM.
Wash CFSE labeled cells twice with PBS.
Recount the washed CFSE labeled cells.
Adjust the cell concentration to 5 × 10^6 cells/mL in serum-free IMDM.
Warm the tube containing the cells at 37°C and shake it in an ultrasonic bath for a while if needed.
Dissolve candidate peptides in DMSO at a concentration of 10 mM.
Seed T2A2 cells into 96-well plates with 10^5 cells per well in 200 μL medium.
Incubate T2A2 cells with candidate peptides at a final concentration of 20 μM for 4 hours at 37°C.
Harvest peptide-loaded T2-A2 cells from the incubation step.
Centrifuge the harvested cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in primary T cell medium to a final concentration of approximately 2.5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Mix 0.5 × 10^6 CD8+ T cells isolated from healthy donors with 0.5 × 10^6 peptide-loaded T2-A2 cells.
Seed the mixed cells into 96-well plates with 200 μL per well.
Add 1 μg/mL anti-CD28 antibody and 50 IU/mL IL-2 to each well.
Incubate the mixed cells at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment.
Every two days, carefully take 50 μL of old medium along the 96-well plate wall and discard it.
Add 50 μL fresh T cell culture medium containing 50 IU/mL IL-2 and 20 μM mixed peptide to each well.
Transfer the 96-well plates from the incubator to the hood carefully, avoiding shaking.
Mix the cells in each well thoroughly.
Transfer 30 μL of cell suspension (1 × 10^6 cells) into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Add 5 μL Human TruStain FcX™ per million cells in a total volume of 100 μL for blocking, mix well, and incubate at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Incubate the cells with 5 μL anti-CD69 antibody per million cells in 100 μL staining volume on ice in the dark for 20 minutes.
Wash the cells twice with cell staining buffer by centrifugation at 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μL cell staining buffer.
Add 5 μL 7-AAD viability staining solution per million cells to exclude dead cells.
Incubate on ice for 3–5 min in the dark.
Perform flow cytometric analysis.
MHC tetramer staining of human CD8+ T cells.
Transfer cells from each well into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend each pellet with 100 μL cold cell staining buffer by gentle swirling.
Add 5 μL Human TruStain FcX™ per million cells in 100 μL staining volume, mix and incubate at 25°C for 10 min.
Add 2 μL of corresponding Flex-T™ complex prepared, mix and incubate in the dark for 1 h at 25°C.
Add 2 μL APC labeled human CD8+ (clone T8), mix and incubate in the dark for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash once with at least 1.5 mL cell staining buffer by centrifugation at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μL cell staining buffer.
Add 5 μL/million cells of 7-AAD viability staining solution to exclude dead cells.
Incubate on ice for 3–5 min in the dark.
Perform flow cytometric analysis within 2 h.
Quickly thaw the Leukocyte Activation Cocktail in a water bath at 37°C.
Add 2 μL of Leukocyte Activation Cocktail to 1 mL cell culture containing ∼10^6 cells/mL and mix thoroughly.
Culture in CO2 incubator at 37°C for 6 hours.
Harvest cells from each well into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the samples at 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend each pellet in 100 μL cold cell staining buffer by gentle swirling.
Add 5 μL of Human TruStain FcX™ per million cells in 100 μL staining volume.
Mix and incubate at 25°C for 10 min.
Add 2 μL APC labeled human CD8+ to the mixture.
Mix and incubate in the dark for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash once with at least 1.5 mL cell staining buffer by centrifugation at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Fix cells in 0.5 mL/tube Fixation Buffer in the dark for 20 min at 25°C.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash cells with Cell Staining Buffer.
Re-suspend the cells in Cell Staining Buffer.
Store the re-suspended cells at 4°C for short-term storage or at −80°C in a cell cryopreservation solution for long-term storage.
Alternatively, store cells in Cyto-Last™ Buffer for up to 2 weeks.
Dilute 10 × permeabilization wash buffer stock solution to 1 × in sterile nuclease-free ddH2O.
Resuspend fixed cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5–10 min.
Repeat the resuspension and centrifugation steps twice.
Perform intracellular staining for IFN-γ and Granzyme B.
Resuspend fixed/permeabilized cells in residual Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer.
Add 5 μL/tests of fluorophore-conjugated antibody (PerCP-IFN-γ and FITC-Granzyme B) to the resuspended cells.
Incubate the mixture for 20 min at 25°C in the dark.
Wash twice with 1.5 mL of Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the fixed and intracellular labeled cells with 0.2 mL cell staining buffer.
Perform flow cytometric analysis after setting photomultiplier tube voltage and compensation using cell surface staining controls.
Set quadrant markers based on isotype controls, unstained cells, or blocking controls.
Examine the stained cells by optical microscope and/or flow light scattering mode to confirm dispersion.
Generate bivariate dot plots or probability contour plots during data analysis.
